answer: In the agent economy a vertex of the trust graph earns full weight only after receiving vouchers from established peers, each of whom locks a bond. Those bonds are slashed if later clustering detects the vouchee as part of a sybil nebula. A gale of new identities therefore requires a matching gale of independent risk-taking vouchers; the attacker cannot manufacture them in bulk because each voucher is a scarce, slashable commitment from an unrelated established agent.
